items.t: Battery capacity loss on 24 kWh packs
items.note: Used or rebuilt packs cost less. Upgrading to a bigger pack costs more and may need extra parts.

items.t: Faster than expected loss on 30 kWh packs
items.note: Within 8 years or 100,000 miles, Nissan's capacity warranty may cover it; check with a dealer. Used packs cost less.

items.t: On-board charger failure - car will not charge
items.note: Used chargers and board-level repair services cost much less than a new dealer part.

items.t: Weak 12V battery causes no-start and false warnings
items.note: Test the 12-volt battery first whenever a Leaf shows many warning lights at once.

items.job: Replace passenger seat cushion with occupant sensor
items.note: Nissan sells the sensor only with the seat parts. A good used seat costs much less. Ask the dealer about goodwill help.

items.t: Passenger airbag may turn off with an adult seated (recall)
items.note: Free under Nissan's recall. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Passenger airbag inflator may not deploy right (recall)
items.note: Free under Nissan's airbag recall. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Passenger airbag connector can come loose (recall)
items.job: Check airbag connector; replace module or harness if needed
items.note: Free under Nissan's recall. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Brake assist can weaken in extreme cold (recall)
items.note: Free software update under Nissan's recall. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Inverter can fail and shut the car down (recall)
items.note: Free under Nissan's 2014 inverter recall. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Front structural part may be missing welds (recall)
items.job: Inspect welds; replace front structural member if needed
items.note: Free under Nissan's recall. Most cars only need the inspection. Check your VIN.

items.t: Battery can overheat during DC fast charging (recall)
items.note: Free under Nissan's recall. Avoid DC fast charging until it is done. Check your VIN.

items.t: Car may speed up after leaving cruise control (recall)
items.note: Free software update under Nissan's recall. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Automatic emergency braking activates for no reason
items.job: Update and recalibrate front radar and camera
items.note: Ask the dealer about Nissan's service bulletins. If the radar sensor or bracket must be replaced, cost rises a lot.

items.t: Rear camera image goes blank or distorted (recall)
items.job: Inspect and reroute camera harness; replace if damaged
items.note: Free under Nissan's camera recall. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Rear window glass may not stay secured (recall)
items.note: Free under Nissan's recall. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Right-side brake tube can corrode and leak (recall)
items.job: Replace right-side brake tube and bleed brakes
items.note: Free under Nissan's recall. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Battery module can short out - fire risk (recall)
items.job: Inspect battery and replace faulty modules
items.note: Free under Nissan's recall. Park outside and don't charge until it is fixed. Check your VIN.

items.t: Rear seat belt locking may release early (recall)
items.job: Replace rear outboard seat belt assemblies
items.note: Free under Nissan's recall once parts are available. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.
